name: token-audit
description: Audit your local Claude Code token usage: cost by model, project, session, cache and effort, with a self-contained HTML dashboard

publish.title: Publish dashboard as artifact
publish.description: always: Claude publishes the dashboard as a private artifact after each audit and gives you the link (default). ask: asks first. never: only writes the local dashboard.html.

anonymize.title: Anonymize project names
anonymize.description: Replace project names with project-1, project-2, ... in the dashboard (recommended if you will share it).
